caption:
Inside a microgravity module, a man with short gray hair, glasses, a green polo shirt, tan trousers and a black wristwatch floats in the left foreground, viewed from behind. He extends his right hand and balances a small metallic dome-shaped object on the tip of his index finger. The white paneled wall behind him is crossed by a thin diagonal cable and a horizontal dark cable, with two circular hatch covers at the top, a fabric bag on the right and a blue rail along the bottom.

Across the bulk of the excerpt the object remains resting on the fingertip, but the hand and the object together drift slowly downward relative to the panel, and the dark horizontal cable likewise slides down across the surface. The hatch covers, the fabric bag, the blue rail and the upper anchor of the diagonal cable keep their positions, while the man's head and torso hold their orientation. The change is gradual, a slow floating descent rather than a perfectly fixed pose.

Toward the close the object lifts off the fingertip and blurs, leaving a horizontal smear trailing across the panel as it drifts away.

He extends his right hand and balances a small metallic dome-shaped object on the tip of his index finger. Across the bulk of the excerpt the metallic object remains resting on the fingertip with essentially no change in position relative to the hand or the panel.
